proves.claim: two branches that each add a plan shard row and a data-read row compose with both rows in both orders.

merge.plan-data.composes-both-rows.why: A plain text merge of two appended rows conflicted although neither side changed the other's row.

proves.claim: a data-read row and a shard row edited differently on both sides still refuse MERGE_CONFLICT.

merge.plan-data.refuses-divergent-rows.why: Composing must never silently pick one side of a real edit conflict.

proves.claim: a conflict in any other file still refuses.

merge.plan-data.refuses-other-conflicts.why: Composition applies only to the plan and data-read files.

proves.claim: an item whose own branch merges cleanly gets no conflict warning although its seat checkout branch conflicts.

merge.carriage.clean-branch-no-warning.why: A warning judged from the seat's checkout branch told builders to fix conflicts they did not have (#3820).

proves.claim: an item whose own branch really conflicts with the new main gets one warning naming the conflicting file.

merge.carriage.real-conflict-one-warning.why: A real conflict must be named once, with its file, so the builder acts on it (#3820).

proves.claim: every merge-cell test registered here has a stable ID and one complete record, and an unregistered test is reported and fails only with tests.registryStrict on.

merge.registry.complete.why: Without a record per test a test can be deleted or duplicated with no one noticing what it proved.
